meta.name: what-the
meta.description: What the? Use when the user wants a plain-English breakdown of something technical — the who, what, where, why, and when.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用大白话解释任何技术概念
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需要向非技术人员解释技术概念
copy.tagline_en: Explain any technical concept in plain English
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain technical concepts to non-technical people

howto.what: 装上后,当你丢给 Claude 一段技术内容,它会用平实的语言把它拆成人、事、地、因、时几个方面讲清楚,而不是堆术语。
howto.when: 当你想把某个技术性内容讲成大白话,需要拆出谁、什么、为什么等要素时,它会接管。

say.text: 用大白话讲讲这个技术东西
这段文档在说什么?讲人话
跟我说说它的来龙去脉
say.note: 覆盖对象、起因与时间等要素

howto.what_en: Once installed, when you hand it something technical, Claude breaks it down in plain English — the who, what, where, why, and when — instead of piling on jargon.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you want a technical subject explained in plain language and broken into who, what, why and the rest.

say_en.text: Explain this technical thing in plain English
What's this doc saying? Plain language, please
Walk me through the who, what and why of it
say_en.note: Covers the subject, cause and timing
